name: French Advance — Main Line
description: The Advance Variation locks the center early. White gains space and attacking prospects on the kingside; Black must generate counterplay against the d4 base or on the queenside.

lines.name: Advance Variation — Main Line
lines.description: White pushes e5 immediately, gaining a space advantage. Black typically develops the knight to c6 and pressures d4 with ...c5 and ...Qb6.
